rules.name: mig-lal-01-check
rules.sql: WITH cut AS ( SELECT v.tenant_id, v.business_unit, max(v.value_date) AS d FROM opera.valuation_date_table v GROUP BY v.tenant_id, v.business_unit ), expected AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (d.tenant_id, d.business_unit, d.trade_id) d.tenant_id, d.business_unit, d.trade_id, d.value_date, d.active_lots FROM opera.deal_active_lots_table d JOIN cut c ON c.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND c.business_unit = d.business_unit AND d.value_date <= c.d ORDER BY d.tenant_id, d.business_unit, d.trade_id, d.value_date DESC ), actual AS ( SELECT l.tenant_id, l.business_unit, l.trade_id, l.value_date, l.active_lots FROM opera.latest_active_lot l ), j AS ( SELECT coalesce(e.tenant_id, a.tenant_id) AS tenant_id, coalesce(e.business_unit, a.business_unit) AS business_unit, e.trade_id AS e_trade, a.trade_id AS a_trade, (e.value_date IS DISTINCT FROM a.value_date OR e.active_lots IS DISTINCT FROM a.active_lots) AS diff FROM expected e FULL JOIN actual a ON a.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND a.business_unit = e.business_unit AND a.trade_id = e.trade_id ) SELECT j.tenant_id, j.business_unit, count(j.e_trade) AS expected_rows, count(j.a_trade) AS cache_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE j.a_trade IS NULL) AS missing, count(*) FILTER (WHERE j.e_trade IS NULL) AS extra, count(*) FILTER (WHERE j.e_trade IS NOT NULL AND j.a_trade IS NOT NULL AND j.diff) AS different FROM j GROUP BY j.tenant_id, j.business_unit ORDER BY j.tenant_id, j.business_unit

expect.reason: no trade missing in any BU
no extra cache row in any BU
no cache row with another date or lots

rules.sql: SELECT count(*) AS triggers, count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.tgenabled NOT IN ('O', 'A')) AS disabled, string_agg(c.relname || '.' || t.tgname || '=' || t.tgenabled, ', ' ORDER BY c.relname, t.tgname) AS detail FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid WHERE c.relnamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND t.tgname LIKE 'trg_%latest_active_lot%' AND NOT t.tgisinternal

expect.reason: the latest_active_lot sync triggers exist after cutover (4 expected)

rules.sql: SELECT s.n_live_tup, s.last_analyze::text AS last_analyze, s.last_autoanalyze::text AS last_autoanalyze FROM pg_stat_user_tables s WHERE s.schemaname = 'opera' AND s.relname = 'latest_active_lot'
